extracted.intended_audience: Heads of executive departments and establishments; agency officials responsible for position management and employment ceiling controls
extracted.subtask_description: An OMB transmittal memorandum notifying agencies that portions of OMB Circular A-64 relating to full-time equivalent (FTE) employment ceilings are rescinded and that employment ceiling instructions are consolidated in OMB Circular A-11. It identifies which sections of A-64 are rescinded, which documents are superseded, and what remains in effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidation of employment ceiling instructions in OMB Circular A-11
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective with the issuance of OMB Circular No. A-11, Transmittal Memorandum No. 54, dated July 19, 1983, the provisions of Circular No. A-64 pertaining to employment ceilings and Bulletin No. 83-5 are superseded by relevant portions of Circular No. A-11 (e.g., section 13 and Appendix D).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All instructions regarding the derivation, issuance, monitoring and reporting of full-time equivalent (FTE) employment ceilings are contained in OMB Circular No. A-11. Agencies should refer to A-11 (not A-64 or Bulletin No. 83-5) for employment ceiling controls and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rescission — references to employment ceilings in section 1 (Policy) of A-64
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifically rescinds references to employment ceilings in section 1 (Policy) of OMB Circular No. A-64.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any policy language in A-64 section 1 that references employment ceilings is no longer operative; agencies must follow the corresponding policy and instructions found in A-11.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rescission — references to employment ceilings in section 2(c) of A-64
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifically rescinds references to employment ceilings in section 2(c) of OMB Circular No. A-64.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies should not rely on A-64 section 2(c) for guidance on employment ceilings and must use A-11 provisions instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rescission — Sections 4, 5, and 6 of A-64
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections 4, 5 and 6 of OMB Circular No. A-64 are rescinded insofar as they pertain to employment ceilings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The substantive requirements, procedures, or reporting obligations in A-64 sections 4–6 related to employment ceilings have been removed and replaced by A-11 guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rescission — Attachment C of A-64
rubrics_metrics.description: Attachment C of OMB Circular No. A-64 is rescinded with respect to employment ceilings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any forms, tables, or attachment-specific procedures in Attachment C governing employment ceilings are superseded; agencies should consult A-11 for replacement instructions or formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supersession of OMB Bulletin No. 83-5
rubrics_metrics.description: OMB Bulletin No. 83-5 (October 14, 1982) is superseded by the relevant portions of OMB Circular No. A-11 concerning employment ceilings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where Bulletin No. 83-5 previously modified or supplemented A-64 on employment ceilings, those provisions are now superseded by A-11 and are no longer the controlling guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Position management systems provisions of A-64 remain in effect
rubrics_metrics.description: The portions of OMB Circular No. A-64 that pertain to position management systems remain in effect and are not rescinded by this memorandum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies must continue to follow A-64 for guidance on position management systems, distinct from employment ceiling controls now covered by A-11.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective date linkage to A-11 Transmittal Memorandum No. 54
rubrics_metrics.description: The rescission and supersession are effective with the issuance of OMB Circular No. A-11, Transmittal Memorandum No. 54, dated July 19, 1983.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies should treat A-11 (Transmittal Memo No. 54, 7/19/1983) as the effective source/date for the changeover of employment ceiling controls; actions and reporting should align with that effective date.
